artworks.title: Jean Francois Paul de Gondy
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man in a three-quarter view, facing right. He has defined facial features - cheekbones, nose, and closed mouth. He has medium-length, wavy hair parted in the middle. He wears formal clerical attire, including a textured robe with a fur-like collar, a broad collar, and a cross pendant on a chain. The portrait is in an octagonal frame with surrounding inscriptions. The background is plain with detailed shading.

artworks.title: Henri de Lorraine, duc de Guise
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Justus Sustermans
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.2 x 23.6 cm (11 1/2 x 9 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with wavy, shoulder-length hair, facing slightly to the right. He has strong facial features, including a prominent nose and a short mustache. The man is wearing a suit of armor with a patterned sash over his right shoulder and a lace collar. The portrait is bordered by an octagonal frame with inscribed text around it, and the background consists of delicate line work.

artworks.title: Henri de Lorraine, comte d'Harcourt
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 30.3 x 24.7 cm (11 15/16 x 9 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man in an upper-body portrait. He is in a three-quarter view with his head slightly turned towards the viewer. He has an elongated face, a prominent mustache, and a goatee. His hair is curly, voluminous, and shoulder-length, framing his face. He wears an ornate garment with intricate patterns and textures, possibly resembling armor, and a luxurious sash across his chest. He also dons a lace collar, decorative bows, and an earring. The backdrop features a textured surface surrounding a detailed, hexagonal frame with an inscription about the individual depicted.

artworks.title: Jean du Verger de Hauranne
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a portrait, shown from the chest up. He is positioned in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to his left. The man has a high forehead, prominent cheekbones, a closely cropped beard and mustache, and thinning hair towards the back of his head. He wears a collared garment with detailed embroidery and a string tie at the collar. The portrait is within an ornate oval frame with surrounding text and script below the image. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Jean Verger de Hauranne
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 30.6 x 24.7 cm (12 1/16 x 9 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing the upper body of a man facing forward but slightly turned to one side. He has a serious expression with deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a slightly furrowed brow. His head is partially bald with hair around the sides and back. The man is dressed in an elaborate garment with a high collar and fine detailing on the sleeves and front. The background consists of an octagonal frame with inscriptions on each side, creating a sense of formality around the portrait.

artworks.title: Henry II
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after François Clouet
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a beard and mustache, looking at the viewer with a composed expression. He wears a plumed hat, richly decorated Renaissance clothing, and is framed within an octagonal border. Below the portrait is an inscription that reads "Henry Second, Roy de France."

artworks.title: Henry IV
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Louis Elle I
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 30.7 x 21.3 cm (12 1/16 x 8 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person facing slightly right, with a calm expression. He has a full face with deeply set eyes, a prominent nose, and a small mustache and beard. His hair is wavy and combed back. He wears an elaborate robe with intricate patterns, a high collar, and a sash across his chest. The robe appears to have armor underneath, textured to indicate its rigidity and shine. The background is dark, and the portrait is framed in an octagon. There is a name or inscription in elegant script at the bottom.

artworks.title: Corneille Jansenius, Bishop of Ypres
artworks.artist: Jean Morin
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust portrait of a person in profile, facing right. The individual has angular facial features with a long nose and strong jawline. They have short wavy hair under a cloth cap. The person wears a robe with a high collar and is not wearing jewelry or holding objects. The background consists of engraved lines creating a textured pattern. The portrait is framed in an octagonal frame with an inscription along its border, giving the image a historical and engraved look.

artworks.title: Louis XI
artworks.artist: Jean Morin
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 30.6 x 21.4 cm (12 1/16 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a detailed profile etching of a man, showing his body from the chest up. The man is depicted in profile, facing to the right. He has a prominent nose, slightly open lips, and his eyes appear thoughtful and focused. The man is wearing a close-fitting hat that covers his head entirely except for his face, with a decorative element on the side. His clothing is richly detailed, with a robe featuring an ornate design along the neckline. The robe appears to be fastened with tassel-like embellishments along the shoulders. The background of the image is textured and framed in an octagonal shape, positioned within a larger rectangle. At the bottom, there is a text inscription stating "Louis XI, Roy de France."

artworks.title: Louis XIII
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features an engraving showing the upper half of a man's body. He is portrayed seated at a slight angle, with long wavy hair reaching his shoulders and a distinct mustache. The man's facial features are sharp and defined, with a composed expression. He wears a detailed garment, including an elaborate lace collar and intricate patterns on his attire, possibly armor or formal ceremonial dress. A draped cloth on his right shoulder complements his outfit. The background shows an octagonal frame with inscriptions around the edges.

artworks.title: Rene de Longueil, marquis de Maisons
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: This image features a portrait of a man from the chest up, turned slightly to his left but facing forward. He has curly hair reaching his jawline and a prominent mustache. The man has a serious expression and is wearing a textured coat with intricate patterns, along with a large scarf or collar draped around his shoulders. The portrait is framed within an octagonal frame with inscriptions, set against a textured background.

artworks.title: Michel de Marillac
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the chest up, facing slightly to his right with a direct expression. He has a short beard and mustache, a receding hairline, with short combed-back hair and a cap on his head. The man is dressed in an elaborate outfit with a high-collared shirt and a decorative robe or cloak. The clothing appears rich in texture. He is surrounded by an intricate frame with inscriptions along its edges, against a plain background that highlights the portrait's detailed engraving.

artworks.title: Cardinal Mazarin
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.9 x 24 cm (11 3/4 x 9 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man positioned frontally but slightly turned to his left. He has a middle-aged appearance with a prominent nose, thin lips, and a slight moustache. His hair is shoulder-length, wavy, and appears to be thinning on top. He is wearing what seems to be ecclesiastical clothing, including a robe with a large collar and a tassel. The man is surrounded by an ornate, octagonal frame with inscriptions on it. The background is plain and textured, focusing attention on the subject.

artworks.title: Jacques le Mercier
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in period attire with long curly hair, a mustache, and a calm expression. He is wearing a skull cap and has a large collar. The background is plain, and the portrait is framed by a border with engraved lettering identifying him as "Le Mercier," the premier architect in French.

artworks.title: Philippe II, King of Spain
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Titian
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a frontal portrait engraving of a man's upper body. He is positioned slightly to the right and has a prominent forehead, short hairstyle, pointed beard, and mustache. His expression is serious with his gaze directed to the side. He is wearing an elaborate velvet coat with fur lining, decorative buttons, and a chain necklace. The background is a textured surface within an ornate octagonal frame with engraved text that reads "PHILIPPES. SECOND. ROI. DES. ESPAGNES. ET. DES. INDES."

artworks.title: Cardinal Richelieu
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person from the chest up. The person's face has a neat mustache and a thin beard. The hair is short and wavy, and the person is wearing a cap. The clothing includes a high starched collar, a long gown, and a cross-shaped medallion. The background features a decorative frame with Latin text surrounding the subject.

artworks.title: Saint Francois de Sales
artworks.artist: Jean Morin
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 30.9 x 20.6 cm (12 3/16 x 8 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man from the shoulders up. The man faces the viewer solemnly, with a high forehead, pronounced brows, and a full beard. His hair is short and receding, and he wears ecclesiastical clothing with a buttoned collar and an embroidered vestment. He also wears a large chain with a cross around his neck. The background is textured and dark, with a lighter-toned inner frame resembling stone. An inscription at the bottom identifies him as François de Sales.

artworks.title: Michel le Tellier
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to his left, showing a three-quarter view of his face. The man has a long face, high cheekbones, a pointed nose, and a mustache. His wavy, shoulder-length hair frames his face. He is dressed in a garment with a wide, flat collar over a buttoned-up shirt. The portrait is enclosed in an octagonal frame with text around it. The background is plain to keep the focus on the man.

artworks.title: Jacques Auguste de Thou
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Louis Elle I
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body, focused on his face and shoulders. He is looking straight at the viewer, with a prominent forehead, strong cheekbones, and a well-defined nose. He has facial hair above his lip and on his chin, and his hair is short and receding. The man is dressed in dark, formal clothing with an elaborate ruffled collar. The background includes an oval-shaped frame with Latin text inscribed around it, set against a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Jacques Tuboeuf
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a man shown from the chest up. He is posed facing slightly towards the viewer’s left, with his head turned to look directly at the viewer. The man's facial expression is neutral with a hint of a smile. He has a mustache and small patch of a beard on his chin. His hair is curly and voluminous, with curls framing the sides of his face, resting just above his shoulders. He is wearing a dark, formal garment which includes a wide, white collar that extends outward; tied at the front with a thin ribbon. Around him, there is a decorative, octagonal frame with an inscription engraved on it. The background of the image is plain and subtly lined, providing a simple contrast to the intricately detailed portrait.

artworks.title: Jean Baptiste Amidor Vignerod
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man depicted from the waist up, seated with his body angled slightly towards the right, and his head facing the viewer directly. He has a youthful face with smooth features and curly hair that falls to just above his shoulders. He is dressed in a traditional, formal garment with a broad white collar and a cloak draped over his shoulders, fastened at the neck with a decorative brooch. He holds a book in his left hand with fingers resting on the cover. The background is simple, with a draped cloth creating a subtle textured quality behind him. The image features an intricate etched style typical of historical portraiture.

artworks.title: Francois de Villemontee
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. He is positioned facing slightly to his right, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a narrow face, a mustache, and a thin beard on his chin. His hair is medium-length and wavy, extending to the level of his shoulders. He is wearing a formal garment, which looks like a robe with pleated detailing, and a white collar with a tassel at the neck. The background consists of a detailed line-engraved texture, and the portrait is framed within an octagonal border with engraved text running along its edges. The text on the frame contains various inscriptions.

artworks.title: Nicholas de Neufville, marquis de Villeroy
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling, touched with black ink, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 30.4 x 23.7 cm (11 15/16 x 9 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the chest up. He is facing slightly to his left, with a prominent nose, a mustache, and long, curly hair falling to his shoulders. He wears armor with a shoulder plate and a white, lace-trimmed collar. The man is set against a dark background with an ornate, octagonal border. An inscription in capital letters decorates the frame.

artworks.title: Antoine Vitre
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. He is seated and turned slightly to his right, with his gaze directed toward the viewer. His facial features include a high forehead, prominent cheekbones, and a mustache; his hair is long, wavy, and reaches his shoulders. He is wearing a robe or cloak over a plain garment with a patterned tie or cravat at the collar. On a surface in front of him are papers and a mathematical or drawing instrument. The background is plain.
